disputes.reason_a: Guide 'financial_guarantee': 'protected' carries the guarantee relation, but the same post says nothing on the page is a guarantee and holders can lose everything, i.e. a disclaimed guarantee, which is negative.
disputes.reason_b: 'Fully protected' denies risk without the word guarantee, so intent is RISK_REMOVED, but the same post disclaims it two lines down ('nothing on the page is a guarantee and holders can lose their entire stake'), and the guide makes a DISCLAIMED guarantee negative. The claim sits on an unnamed project's pinned post, an uncheckable source, so unverified_information survives.
